rationale: The split follows the trust boundary the architecture already draws. The OS layer carries the user-protective guarantees, so copyleft does real work there: an OEM cannot take the privileged broker, weaken its permission enforcement, and ship the result closed. The Phase 7 client packages are integration surfaces that a third-party fleet server, enterprise console or OEM tooling must embed to interoperate at all, and ADR-023 deliberately places those components in separate repositories; a copyleft obligation on enterprise/ would reach into deployments this project neither wrote nor supports.
attestationNote: The project owner selected this model explicitly on 2026-07-29 from the four options set out in docs/LICENCE_DECISION.md. The decision is attested by the recorded decision document, not by a cryptographic signature: no owner signing key exists, and docs/PRODUCTION_SIGNING_CEREMONY.md records that no key ceremony has been held. Adding a signature is tracked as an open item rather than simulated.
